bio: This charming Basque “asador”, impressively run by the Bereciartua family, occupies a delightful 16C country house in a riverside location. The open grill, which is completely visible from the dining room, is at the very heart of the Basque-inspired cooking on offer here. Whatever you order, from its splendid meats to its superb fish dishes, make sure you leave room for the cheesecake!...
